the synthesis of Ru nanocrystals with different crystallographic structures by tuning the lattice mismatch between the Ru overlayer and the underlying Pd Cu alloy substrates.
the synthesis, characterization, and properties of metal nanoparticles (NPs).
the synthesis of metal nanomorphologies through the epitaxial overgrowth of Ru nanocrystals on the surface of a Pd Cu alloy substrate.

epitaxial growth can induce a shape transformation of metal nanocrystals and can be used to tune the crystallographic structures of metals.
